headline: Callahans Passage Ignites as Wardens Restore Control Over Viper Pit
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Callahan's Passage has become the war's sharpest flashpoint, recording five strategic base transitions across the past two hours amidst over twenty-three hundred combined casualties. In Viper Pit, Warden forces reclaimed Moltworth to restore complete provincial control following three further base contests. Stlican Shelf maintained active friction with two base flips over the last two hours, driven by accelerating casualty rates around Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. Meanwhile, previous surges in Nevish Line and Fisherman's Row slowed, though Fisherman's Row still logged an isolated exchange at Dankana Post. Massive bloodshed persisted across Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, where combined two-hour tolls reached over thirty-two hundred and eleven hundred casualties respectively, despite strategic ownership remaining stable in the latest two-hour interval. Dead Lands, Linn of Mercy, and Marban Hollow remain subdued into quiet standoffs.
